description: Settings, Landing pages: the Default page (the default-site setting), the seven global pages and the visit time

visit_time.description: How the built-in pages show the visit time: utc, local, or local-utc for both. Default: utc

value.description: congratulations (the built-in page), 404 (the not found page), 444 (nginx closes the connection without an answer), redirect (a 302 to meta.redirect) or html (the page in meta.html)

meta.description: Extra values of the chosen value: redirect, html and status, as for the default site setting

default_site.description: What a request for an unknown host gets (the default-site setting)

not_found.description: Shown when a page is not found: by a 404 host, and by a proxy host that chooses a 404 page

upstream_error.description: Shown in place of an upstream 502, 503 or 504 answer, for example when the upstream cannot be reached

denied.description: Shown when an access list refuses a visitor

maintenance.description: Shown by a proxy host in maintenance mode (503)

certificate.description: Shown for plain HTTP to a host that forces HTTPS while its certificate files are missing

ban.description: Shown to a visitor CrowdSec bans

captcha.description: Shown to a visitor CrowdSec sends to a captcha

pages.description: The seven global pages, one per kind. A host or access list can use them or its own page

choice.description: npmpro for the built-in page, custom for the HTML in html
